## Honesty limits

- [ ] No text claims certification, safety, authorization, regulatory compliance, or outside validation or review that does not exist.
- [ ] No invented contact address, handle, URL or channel.
- [ ] No credentials, personal records, private paths or raw private traces.
- [ ] Counts and numbers I state were checked by running the command.
